title: Verify live site deployment and rendering
description: Check the GitHub Actions pipeline to ensure it passes, visit the live github.io URL, and verify that the application (LaTeX rendering) works as expected in the production environment.

title: Configure Repo Settings for GitHub Pages
description: Change the repository settings in GitHub to use GitHub Actions as the source for Pages (can be done via human or gh CLI)

title: Update README with live URL
description: Add the live github.io URL to the README.md so users can visit the site

title: Add GitHub Actions workflow for Pages
description: Create a workflow file in .github/workflows to deploy public_html to GitHub Pages
notes: Implemented the deploy-pages.yml workflow using standard GitHub Pages setup. I've separated it into 'build' and 'deploy' jobs. The 'build' job checks out the repo, sets up Node.js 20, runs 'npm ci' and 'npm test' to verify tests pass, configures pages, and uploads the 'public_html' directory as the artifact. The 'deploy' job waits for 'build' and then uses 'deploy-pages@v4' to actually deploy to GitHub Pages. The YAML syntax has been verified.

title: Epic: Setup GitHub Pages Deployment
description: Make the InstantLaTeX repository a live github.io site using GitHub Actions

title: Update CDN dependencies and MathJax to v3
description: Upgrade old CDNs (e.g., bootstrap, jquery) and upgrade MathJax to v3. Update main.js to match MathJax 3 API. Add tests if needed.
notes: Updated Bootstrap to 3.4.1, jQuery to 3.7.1, and MathJax to v3. Rewrote main.js typeset logic to use MathJax 3 promise queue. Fixed jQuery load() event to on('load') for 3.x compatibility.

title: Initialize JS test setup (Jest)
description: Initialize package.json, add Jest for unit tests. Don't use mocks. Focus on TDD.
notes: Initialized package.json and installed Jest as a dev dependency. Configured the 'test' script in package.json to run jest. Wrote a simple smoke test in tests/smoke.test.js following Red/Green TDD (ensured it failed first, then fixed it to pass). Added node_modules/ to .gitignore to prevent committing dependencies.

title: Extract JS and CSS
description: Move JS to main.js, CSS to main.css. Write unit tests for JS functions using the new Jest setup.
notes: Extracted inline CSS to main.css and inline JS to main.js. Extracted core MathJax formatting logic into a formatMath function in main.js, which is exported for Jest in Node environments and left in global scope for the browser. Added main.test.js with unit tests using red/green TDD. Tests passed.
